title: SmartComms
description: Adds special commands like /home for fast transportation
body:
Follow On Instagram: [@nv.labs.official](https://www.instagram.com/nv.labs.official/)

SmartComms is a lightweight server-side Fabric mod that adds simple, reliable home commands to Minecraft 1.21.11. It’s built to be small, focused, and easy to understand, so server owners and players can get quality-of-life teleport features without any extra clutter, config files, or complex permissions systems. Drop it into your mods folder on a Fabric server or singleplayer instance and you’re ready to go.

Use **_/sethome_** to save your current position as your personal home, **_/home_** to instantly return there, and **_/delhome_** to remove your saved home when you no longer need it. The **_/smartcomms_** command displays basic information about the mod and its available commands directly in chat. Homes are stored per-player, per-world in a human-readable smartcomms_homes.json file in the world folder, making it easy to back up, edit, or inspect data externally.

Also, more commands will be coming soon once Minecraft 26.1 is FINALLY OUT...

SmartComms requires Fabric Loader, [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), and Java 21.

Check out our other projects: [DarkGUI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/dark_gui), [NightVision](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/nv_1.21.x)
